description: Classic keyword data for a seed term. Omit ideas when the user only needs that seed's monthly search volume, CPC, or competition. Set ideas:true only when the user asks for related, alternative, or long-tail suggestions from provider candidates. Not a multi-model AI-search query. The reply echoes requestedKeyword and carries status "exact" or "no_data"; when the seed has no search volume, any related term that does appears under alternatives — never treat an alternative's metrics as the requested keyword's. Pricing: billed by outcome — cheapest when the seed has no search volume, more when it has metrics, most with ideas:true. Call cite42_pricing for exact current rates. Covers AI-search, citation, SEO, keyword, trend, and market-research data. If a plan needs more than 20 endpoint calls or may use more than $5 USD, estimate the cost in USD and ask the user before continuing. Quote Cite42 costs and balances in USD using cite42Billing or the USD pricing table. Legacy credit fields are for compatibility only. These funds belong to Cite42, not the host or model provider. AI visibility metrics include counts; quote them with percentages, not as a market-wide score. Optional recommendations are a separate paid call, never automatic. After a visibility result, offer recommendations using its requestId; run only when the user requests advice and knows the additional cost. Free: cite42_balance for the remaining balance, cite42_pricing for exact per-tool prices and cost estimates, cite42_usage for recent calls.

country.description: ISO-2 country code for localized metrics. Defaults to "us".

ideas.description: Omit for volume, CPC, and competition on the seed only. Set true only for related, alternative, or long-tail keyword ideas.

language.description: Optional ISO-2 language code. Defaults to the country's primary search language, so country "de" searches in German. Only multilingual markets accept an override: us (en, es), ca (en, fr), in (en, hi). Every other country has a single search language and rejects anything else.

seed.description: Seed keyword or concise topic to fetch search volume, CPC, and competition for.
